dedupe_keys.name: astra open geodata on opendata swiss national roads axes main road network and related federal road datasets

description: The Swiss Federal Roads Office ASTRA publishes its open geodata through the national portal opendata.swiss, where its organisation page read on 2026-09-28 lists 26 datasets. They include the national road axes, by which ASTRA manages and maintains the motorways and national roads, the main road network defined under the MinVV ordinance on the use of mineral oil tax (last updated 21 April 2021), the Federal Inventory of Historical Traffic Routes (IVS), building lines along national roads, road closures, traffic surveillance and accident layers, and the slow traffic networks for hiking, cycling, mountain biking, skating and snowshoeing. Coverage is national, as vector geodata of the federal spatial data infrastructure. Access is free: most datasets are offered as WMS or WMTS services, an API through the federal geoportal and, for five, ZIP downloads; the terms of use are set per dataset on opendata.swiss (the page groups them in two categories, not read one by one). Caveats: several layers are services only, not downloads, update dates differ widely between datasets, and traffic volumes are only partly included. It supports network flow and capacity planning on the Swiss road network and exposure analysis of national roads to natural hazards. No other Swiss road network record exists in the catalogue; it complements European road datasets.
